plotEn: Lapland War (Finnish: Lapin sota) is a 2026 Finnish independent war drama film directed by Aku Louhimies, an adaptation of the 2012 novel by Antti Tuuri, Rauta-antura (2012) . The film depicts the Lapland War, a 1944-1945 war between Finland and Nazi Germany. The actors include Luukas Niskanen, Sannah Nedergård, Peter Franzén and Volker Bruch.
